tools.name: protime_list_clockings
tools.description: List time clockings (in/out, reasons, activities) for a date range. Deleted clockings have status Deleted. Location data is left out. A date range is required (at most one year). Returns one page: pass continuationToken for the next page. Read only. Needs scope connector-protimeapi-clockings.read.

tools.name: protime_list_absences
tools.description: List absence instances (leave, sickness) for a date range. A date range is required (at most one year). Returns one page: pass continuationToken for the next page. Read only. Needs scope connector-protimeapi-absences.read.

tools.name: protime_list_assignments
tools.description: List work assignments (planned and registered activities) for a date range. A date range is required. Returns one page: pass continuationToken for the next page. Read only. Needs scope connector-protimeapi-assignments.read.

tools.name: protime_list_contracts
tools.description: List employment contracts (percentage, hours, dates). Optional person filter. Returns one page: pass continuationToken for the next. Read only. Needs scope connector-protimeapi-contracts.read.

tools.name: protime_list_people
tools.description: List people with name, work email and service dates. Home address, birth date, bank, passport and social security data are never returned. Optional person filter. Pass continuationToken for the next page. Read only. Needs scope connector-protimeapi-people.read.

tools.name: protime_list_departments
tools.description: List all departments configured in the tenant. No filters. Pass continuationToken for the next page. Read only. Needs scope connector-protimeapi-departments.read.

tools.name: protime_list_jobs
tools.description: List all jobs configured in the tenant. No filters. Pass continuationToken for the next page. Read only. Needs scope connector-protimeapi-jobs.read.

tools.name: protime_list_work_locations
tools.description: List all work locations configured in the tenant. No filters. Pass continuationToken for the next page. Read only. Needs scope connector-protimeapi-work-locations.read.

tools.name: protime_list_shift_definitions
tools.description: List all shift definitions (codes and names) configured in the tenant. No filters. Pass continuationToken for the next page. Read only. Needs scope connector-protimeapi-shift-definitions.read.

tools.name: protime_list_absence_definitions
tools.description: List all absence definitions (codes, groups) configured in the tenant. No filters. Pass continuationToken for the next page. Read only. Needs scope connector-protimeapi-absence-definitions.read.

tools.name: protime_list_absence_groups
tools.description: List all absence groups configured in the tenant. No filters. Pass continuationToken for the next page. Read only. Needs scope connector-protimeapi-absence-groups.read.

tools.name: protime_get_person
tools.description: Get one person by internal ID: name, work email, service dates. Sensitive personal data is never returned. Read only. Needs scope connector-protimeapi-people.read.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: protime_list_people, protime_get_person · Public sink: protime_list_people, protime_get_person.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: protime_list_people, protime_get_person · Public sink: protime_list_people, protime_get_person

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
